class.name: DialogueLineNode
class.brief_description: A line of dialogue in a [FlowGraph]: who speaks and what.

method.name: get_translated_speaker_name
method.description: Returns [member speaker_name] translated with [member translation_context]. If [member speaker_name] is empty, returns [method DialogueSpeaker.get_translated_name] of the speaker with the id [member speaker] in [member SubtitleServer.speakers], or [member speaker] itself if there is none.

method.name: get_translated_text
method.description: Returns [member text] translated with [member translation_context] through [method Object.tr]. Returns [member text] unchanged if there is no translation for the current locale.

members.member: The id of the speaker for the game, for example to pick a portrait, a color or a voice bus. Not shown to the player; see [member speaker_name]. The id of a [DialogueSpeaker] in [member SubtitleServer.speakers]; the Inspector suggests these ids.
The name of the speaker as shown to the player. Translatable, see [method get_translated_speaker_name].
Optional subtitles for [member voice], for example to show the line in sync with the recording.
The text of the line, or a translation key. An empty text is a configuration warning.
The translation context of [member text] and [member speaker_name], for texts that are the same in the source language but need different translations.
Optional voice recording of the line. The node does not play it; the dialogue UI does.
